entries.message: Fix - Make personal rating sync resolve provider identities
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Reads personal ratings with the authenticated provider account and preserves episode identity across providers
Resolves normalized TV records and episode series titles before writing ratings
Shows failed, unmatched, and reauthentication-required rating work in sync settings
Cancels interrupted onboarding imports on restart and blocks imports after setup completion
Adds regression coverage for provider rating resolution and onboarding recovery
